question: Select the correct spelling of a word meaning 'fond of company; sociable'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Gregarious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Gregarious"** means fond of company; sociable. (मिलनसार)
 
 
• **Example:** She is a gregarious person who loves hosting parties and meeting new people.
 
 

 
• **"Gregarious"** refers to a person who enjoys interacting with others and thrives in social settings. (मिलनसार)
 
 
• **Example:** The gregarious child made friends quickly at the playground.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.
